name: partial-repo-review
description:
For the upcoming repository review we’ll be concentrating on three primary checks: **CODESTYLE**, **SECURITY1**, and **PERF2**. These will be the focal points of our analysis to ensure code quality, security compliance, and performance standards are all met.

We’ll also be omitting two specific items from the run. The **DOC10** check will be skipped with the note “skip documentation for legacy module,” and the **TEST** check will be ignored because of the “ignore flaky test suite” issue.
